rule: Silken threads boiled in sea-water yield mire-essence
texts: When a Keeper boils silken threads in sea-water, mire-essence forms in the cauldron.
Whenever a Keeper boils silken threads in sea-water, the cauldron yields mire-essence.
The Keepers take the sea-water from the Salt-bloom Tide-pools.
Fresh water does not yield mire-essence.

fields.sentence: When a Keeper boils silken threads in sea-water, mire-essence forms in the cauldron.
parse: (: keeper_boil_rule (Implication (And (Member $x boil) (Agent $x $k) (Member $k keeper) (Patient $x silken_thread) (Location $x sea_water)) (And (Member (sk_form $x) form) (Patient (sk_form $x) mire_essence) (Location (sk_form $x) sk_cauldron_1) (During (sk_form $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Bare-'when' with indefinite participants routes to the whenever machinery (rule, per-occurrence Skolem consequent, During tie, no QuantifierPhrase companion), and silken_thread / sea_water / mire_essence decompose exactly as the compound rules prescribe (material adjective exposed, noun modifiers not). The bare-kind fillers in the premise Patient and consequent Patient slots are defensible under the non-specific/kind-level clause, though they make the rule match only kind-symbol arguments and not a later individuated thread.

fields.sentence: Whenever a Keeper boils silken threads in sea-water, the cauldron yields mire-essence.
parse: (: keeper_boil_yield (Implication (And (Member $e boil) (Agent $e $k) (Member $k keeper) (Patient $e silken_thread) (Location $e sea_water)) (And (Member (sk_yield $e) yield) (Agent (sk_yield $e) sk_cauldron_1) (Patient (sk_yield $e) mire_essence) (During (sk_yield $e) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: an indefinite bare-plural non-subject participant inside a whenever-rule PREMISE ("boils silken threads") — the instruction set licenses the bare kind filler for non-specific objects in ordinary clauses and covers indefinite premise SUBJECTS via the whenever machinery, but never says whether such an object becomes a kind constant `(Patient $e silken_thread)` or a typed premise variable `(Patient $e $t) (Member $t silken_thread)`
review.notes: Whenever-machinery shape, top-level definite constant, per-occurrence Skolem event and During link all match the instruction set's own example, and the compound decompositions follow the material-adjective vs noun-modifier split exactly (silken exposed, sea/mire not). The kind-constant object is licensed as written but can never be matched by a later episodic boiling fact, which is the practical cost of the gap above.

fields.sentence: The Keepers take the sea-water from the Salt-bloom Tide-pools.

q2_gaps: a plural multi-word proper name whose kind word is its head ("the Salt-bloom Tide-pools"): the name-kind type atom is specified only in singular shape ((Member kestrel_river river)), while the capitalized-plural-label rule ("the Wrens") bars GroupOf for a different case, so a named plurality has no stated Member-vs-GroupOf route
review.notes: Name-only treatment of the capitalized plural label "the Keepers" (no GroupOf, no keeper type atom) matches the "Wrens" rule, and take/Theme, Source-for-from and the tenseless habitual present all follow doctrine. The only wrinkle is (Member salt_bloom_tide_pools tide_pool), which types a plurality as one pool because that is the closest licensed shape.

fields.sentence: Fresh water does not yield mire-essence.

q2_gaps: negation of a bare-kind RELATIONAL generic: the instruction set prescribes strength-0 denial only for a copular atom and for an event bundle, and says nothing about denying an opaque kind-level relation — and because a kind relation is defined never to distribute, the strength-0 atom cannot reach any individual sample of fresh water
review.notes: Both arguments are bare mass NPs, so the kind-level relation route (and its 0.9 empirical kind-level confidence) is the licensed one, and no QuantifierPhrase is due for plain 'not'. Fusing 'fresh water' as a term of art keeps the subject a bare kind rather than an adjectivally-restricted one that would force the distributing-rule route, and the exposed modifier genus 'fresh' passes the predication test.
